rationale: Daily paid users of Claude Code and Cursor face quantified, recurring token waste (68k–353k tokens for raw HTML vs ~950 for summarized content) and complete failures on JS-rendered/anti-bot pages. Competing products (Firecrawl, Jina Reader) already charge for clean-content APIs, confirming willingness to pay, while the agent-native MCP integration angle and anti-bot bypass remain demonstrably unmet by current solutions.
